_note: Rarities shared by everything that can carry one (Yusuf, 2026-10-22): blueprints first, then items, relics and dawn cards. An entity says "rarity": "<id>" in its own data; no rarity means white. order = rarest last. name = what players read; color = the card or label colour (hex); weight = how much less often a rarer one is offered than a white one where offers are drawn at random (1.0 = as often). Read through Content.rarity_of / rarity_tier / rarity_color / rarity_weight. roll (Yusuf, 2026-10-23): a dealt card rolls its own rarity, apart from how often its kind is offered: roll = [chance in round 1, chance in the last round], climbing evenly between; white is whatever is left. A rolled card carries modifiers (sim/card_roll.gd, data/card_mods.json): blue 1, yellow 2 or 3, orange one transmutation. The card frame shows the roll; a small gem shows the kind's own rarity (how often it turns up). Every dawn card but promotions rolls, and the caravan's trade cards (more often: trade_roll_mult in data/balance.json); a legend hero is a hero card's orange roll.
